business_problem: The city of Valladolid in Spain faces a challenge common to many medium-sized cities: managing and delivering a vast, complex web of services—from social services and public works to registrations and rural activities—across a diverse population. For citizens, finding specific information often meant navigating a tangle of departments and "invisible barriers".
solution_summary: Successfully transitioned from on-premises systems to a secure, flexible cloud environment using Gemini and BigQuery The centerpiece of the city’s transformation is Ana, a generative AI assistant built on Google Cloud using Gemini and with help from LuceIT. To encourage internal adoption, the council "humanized" the technology. They named the assistant after a long-serving colleague, Ana, even creating an avatar in her likeness. This helped reframe AI as an ally that handles routine administrative burdens, allowing human workers to focus on high-value citizen care. LuceIT led the technical deployment, integrating Gemini with municipal data while adhering to strict security and regulatory requirements. By using flexible infrastructure in Google Cloud, the council successfully transitioned from traditional on-prem systems to a modern cloud.

solution_components.role: Powers natural-language reasoning, summarization, generation, or assistance inside the workflow.

solution_components.name: Vertex AI
solution_components.role: Hosts and orchestrates machine learning and generative AI capabilities inside the solution.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets that power the workload.

data_flow: stored or unified in BigQuery, processed with Vertex AI, and surfaced through Gemini
business_outcome: Provides 24/7 automated support for all municipal inquiries with gen AI agent; Manages 300 to 500 citizen queries daily, significantly reducing burden on traditional service channels; Achieved 100% factual information delivery by grounding the AI assistant in audited municipal data sources; Optimizes public spending and maximizes government responsiveness using dashboards with real-time data tracking.

The impact of Ana has been immediate and transformative. Valladolid became the first city council in Spain to deploy a generative AI chatbot of this type, providing citizens with a "digital official" available 24/7.
Expanding 24/7 support to improve resident experiences

With the success of the pilot, the council is already developing Ana 2.0, expanding data sources and adding new communication channels to make Ana the primary point of reference for all municipal information.
